full.description: This is a micrograph of kidney tissue stained with Gomori's trichrome. The image shows numerous renal tubules and a blood vessel. The peri-tubular capillaries are dilated and congested with sickled red blood cells. These findings are characteristic of renal involvement in sickle cell nephropathy.

random.description: This is a histological micrograph of kidney tissue stained to highlight structural changes. The image reveals numerous renal tubules alongside a prominent blood vessel exhibiting marked wall thickening and hyalinization. Interstitial changes and cellular infiltrates are also visible in the surrounding parenchyma. These findings are characteristic of vascular and tubulointerstitial renal pathology, such as nephrosclerosis or chronic renal injury.
